title: Governance Decision
description: Input to and IntentResult of `demo.GetGovernanceDecision`. Same pattern as `fdc3.approval`: one context type for the raise and the result. `subject` is the `fdc3.action` being judged. `log` is a Gemara EvaluationLog: skeleton on the way in (metadata and target, no `result` / `evaluations`); the decision app fills `log.result` (`Passed` / `Needs Review` / `Failed`) and `log.evaluations`. Sail maps those to Allow / Escalate / Deny.

id.title: Identifiers
id.description: Optional FDC3 context `id` map. `requestId` correlates the original raise.

requestId.title: requestId
requestId.description: Caller-generated correlation id, typically the original raiseIntent requestUuid.

signatureJku.title: Signature JKU
signatureJku.description: Protected-header `jku` from the original raise's ContextMetadata.signature, when present. Direct and JEV governance use this for the trusted-approver JWKS check.

signaturePresent.title: Signature present
signaturePresent.description: True when the original raise carried ContextMetadata.signature. The PDP inspects jku / raiser appId; Sail does not decide trust.

log.title: Evaluation Log
log.description: Gemara Evaluation Log document. See https://gemara.openssf.org/schema/. `metadata.type` must be `EvaluationLog`. Skeleton on input; filled on the IntentResult.

result.title: Result
result.description: Filled by the decision app. `Passed` → Allow, `Needs Review` → Escalate (GetApproval), `Failed` → Deny.
